**Comparison to candidates:**
- **Corn_Stunt_Spiroplasma**: Reference shows reddish-purple leaf discoloration and dried late-season plants — no color change visible in test
- **Crazy_top**: Reference (bottom-left panel) matches well — stunted plants with narrow strap-like leaves, excessive tillering, compact bushy structure with multiple shoots; the center plant in the test image shows exactly this compact, multi-shoot, short stature
- **Maize_dwarf_mosaic_virus**: Reference shows distinct yellow/green mosaic striping on leaves — not visible in test image

The stunted plant with narrow, strap-like proliferating leaves and no tassel formation is most consistent with **Crazy_top**.
